messages:
anya-partnerships: FYI - CloudForge marketplace asked for a single evidence package for listing: latest SOC2 summary, most recent pen-test (redacted ok), completed vendor questionnaire, and a brief control mapping doc. They want a presigned artifact link in their portal by Tue AM.

lee-security: I can take SOC2 summary + control mapping. Diego, do you have the raw pen PDF or only the SI redacted copy? We need to know whether to run a second redaction pass.

diego-si: We have both. Raw is in gs://evidence/cloudforge/pen/raw/2025-04-01/pen-test.pdf. Redacted copy -> gs://evidence/cloudforge/pen/redacted/pen-test_redacted.pdf. Raw access is restricted. For partner upload we'll use the redacted one and include redaction notes.

anya-partnerships: Partner requires a manifest with SHA256 checksums and a simple human-readable index of artifacts. Also asked to include who performed redaction + date.

lee-security: I'll prepare control-mapping-cloudforge.pdf (1 page) mapping our control IDs to the vendor questionnaire sections. Will not include links to internal evidence.

tara-legal: Per policy, any raw pen artifacts require an NDA and signed attestation before release. For redacted bundles we need an attestation email chain confirming no customer data included and who redacted. I'll post the attestation template now.

tara-legal: ```
Attestation for Marketplace Evidence v2
- Owner: <name>
- Artifacts included: <filenames>
- Redaction performed by: <name> (describe method)
- Statement: No customer personal data, secrets, or credentials are included. Sensitive IP sections removed as listed.
- NDA ref (if raw): <contract id>
- Date:
Signature:
```

diego-si: Noted. I'll attach redaction_log.txt with the redaction diff and who did it. We usually include redaction_version: v2 and redactor: diego-si.

upload-bot: [system] Role marketplace-uploader provisioned to diego-si with expiry 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z.

anya-partnerships: Upload flow proposal: create folder cloudforge_marketplace_2025-04, put artifacts, generate manifest.sha256, produce zip cloudforge_evidence_202504.zip, upload to private bucket, generate presigned URL with 7-day TTL and limit to 5 downloads. Diego will post the link to partner portal.

lee-security: Redaction checklist highlights: remove all IPs in logs, mask internal hostnames, strip screenshots with emails/user IDs, remove or redact stack traces containing request/response bodies. I'll run secret-scan + trufflehog and produce a short scan report.

diego-si: My usual commands for manifest + zip (I'll copy to staging and run):
```
# in staging folder
sha256sum * > manifest.sha256
zip -r cloudforge_evidence_202504.zip manifest.sha256 *.pdf *.xlsx *.txt
```

anya-partnerships: Please tag the S3 object metadata: partner=cloudforge, listing=marketplace, retention=90d. After 90 days we copy to archive bucket per retention.

lee-security: I'll prepare the SOC2 summary PDF with only control-level bullets (no evidence excerpts). Expect it by Monday EOD.

tara-legal: I'll pre-fill the attestation with artifact names once Diego confirms final filenames. Also confirm whether partner signed our standard marketplace NDA. If not, we need an exec signoff to share raw items.

diego-si: I'll orchestrate presign and upload. Questions: manifest should include filename, sha256, size, redaction_version, redactor, legal_attestation_id?

anya-partnerships: Include redaction_version and redactor. Legal attestation id optional but include a short line in manifest: legal_reviewed_by: tara-legal date. Partner also asked for a contact for a possible pen-test witness session (they may ask to validate firmware signing). We should provide a contact but avoid sharing personal phone numbers — give partner PM email and offer to schedule via calendar.

upload-bot: [system] Note: presign default TTL is 604800s. Max downloads limit is enforced at 10 by policy, but we can set to 5 per partner ask if infra approves.

lee-security: I'll draft the control-mapping 1-pager and the redaction checklist fragment for the partner so they understand what's removed. Diego, can you include the redaction_log.txt in the zip?

diego-si: Yes. redaction_log.txt included. Plan and owners below:
- diego-si: presign + staging upload + manifest + zip creation
- lee-security: SOC2 summary + control mapping + secret-scan report + redaction checklist
- tara-legal: attestation + NDA verification + final sign-off
- anya-partnerships: partner comms + portal link + scheduling witness session if requested

anya-partnerships: Proposed timeline: artifacts ready in staging by Sunday EOD, legal attestation signed by Monday morning, presigned link up Monday noon, portal link by Tue 9am. Sync Friday 9am PT to confirm. I'll invite partner PM.

lee-security: Friday 9am PT works. I'll upload initial scan results before the sync.

tara-legal: I'll review and sign attestation after Lee posts the checklist.

diego-si: Starting staging folder now. Will ping when presign ready.

anya-partnerships: Thanks everyone — let's keep channel updates short. :thumbsup:
